event.title: Lando Norris Claims First 2026 F1 Victory at Hungarian Grand Prix
event.canonical_title: Lando Norris Claims First 2026 F1 Victory at Hungarian Grand Prix
event.summary: Lando Norris secured his first victory of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the Hungarian Grand Prix, driving for McLaren. Defending his title, Norris finished ahead of Max Verstappen, who took second place, while Antonelli completed the podium in third.

event_overview.title: About Formula 1
event_overview.subject: Formula 1
event_overview.summary: Formula 1 is the FIA Formula One World Championship, an international single-seater motor-racing competition staged through a season of Grand Prix events. It awards separate world championship titles to drivers and constructors, with races run under FIA sporting and technical regulations.

facts.label: Governing body and titles
facts.value: The Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile (FIA) organizes the championship, which comprises a World Drivers’ Championship and a World Constructors’ Championship.

facts.label: 2026 season calendar
facts.value: The official 2026 calendar lists 24 championship rounds, beginning with the Australian Grand Prix on March 6–8 and ending with the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix on December 4–6.

facts.label: Hungarian Grand Prix
facts.value: The 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix is round 11 of the championship, held July 24–26 at the Hungaroring near Budapest; the race is scheduled over 70 laps of the 4.381-kilometre circuit.

facts.label: 2026 regulations
facts.value: The 2026 season begins a new FIA regulatory era, including revised technical rules and the use of advanced sustainable fuels.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline follows the July 26 Hungarian Grand Prix result and a Bahrain scheduling development, rather than providing a complete record of the 2026 championship’s races, standings, or regulatory changes.
